answer: Give a newcomer 10 credits by debiting its sponsor's existing budget, never by minting a welcome bonus. Record both sides atomically; new credits arise only from verified paid work. An agent may wander between classifying sable photos and digitizing quill manuscripts, but creating aliases only divides its original allowance. To fund 100 extra accounts, a farm must purchase 1,000 credits from outsiders or earn them through real work. Recursive invitations cannot create spendable credit.
